profile.heroSummary: Studies in foreign policy, diplomacy, regional politics and environmental security, supported by experience in communications, teaching and public-sector record management.
profile.biography: I am Mohammad Ilyas, an MPhil student in International Relations at the University of Management and Technology, Lahore. I hold a BS in International Relations from Lasbela University of Agriculture, Water and Marine Sciences, where my studies covered foreign policy, diplomacy, regional politics, security and international law. My background includes communications work in education, public-sector record management and mathematics teaching, alongside further training in research methodology and climate action. This portfolio brings together my academic development, professional experience and continuing learning.
profile.contactText: For academic discussion or professional enquiries, please get in touch by email or LinkedIn.

research.introduction: My academic background spans foreign policy, diplomacy, regional politics, international law and environmental security. The questions I am interested in developing concern how states cooperate, how institutions respond to shared risks, and how research can inform public discussion. The themes below outline a developing research direction.

interests.title: Foreign policy, diplomacy and regional cooperation
interests.description: Exploring how states define foreign-policy priorities, manage regional relationships, and use diplomacy to address shared problems, with an interest in South Asia and the Middle East.
interests.basis: BS coursework and stated career interests in CV2 p1.

interests.title: Climate policy and environmental security
interests.description: Examining the connections between environmental change, human security, public policy and international cooperation, with particular interest in adaptation and climate communication.
interests.basis: Environmental-security coursework and documented climate-action fellowship.

interests.title: Indian Ocean politics and maritime cooperation
interests.description: Developing an interest in how maritime security, international law and environmental protection shape cooperation in the Indian Ocean.
interests.basis: Indian Ocean politics and international-law coursework.

research.methodsCopy: My further training spans research methodology, academic writing and data analysis. I am developing ways to connect careful reading of policy documents and relevant data with clear communication for academic and wider audiences.
